bindings.caption: Solution 1 was heated under nitrogen atmosphere. temperature: 110 °C. duration: 1 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Solution 2 was heated. temperature: 40 °C. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Solution 2 was injected into solution 1. temperature: 110 °C. duration: 5 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Reaction was stopped by adding cold ethanol. temperature: 5 °C. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

OA-QD dispersion was centrifuged to remove unnecessary material. duration: 3 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Precipitate was redispersed in toluene. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

OA-QD dispersion was centrifuged again. duration: 1 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: three-neck flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
